nl: Vue2 车队管理：查询有车牌号、车辆类型（货车/客车/特种）；表格展示车牌号、车辆类型、里程、年检到期；支持新增、编辑、删除。后端接口返回 { data: [...], total: N }。
nlEn: Vue2 fleet management: query by plate number and vehicle type (truck/bus/special); the table shows plate number, vehicle type, mileage, and inspection due date; supports add, edit, and delete. The backend endpoint returns { data: [...], total: N }.
notes: AI-08: { data, total } mapping on the vue2 target (vue2/schema)
